Hi Sascha/Team,
Greetings of the Day,
As per Markus, Charger is in Norway.
He is planning for go to repair, next tuesday.
Upon investigation,
We have found the charger is on old FW,
We recommend charger to be on latest FW.
We have also investigated the error flags, And found that there is issue in the emergency line.
We need to check for the issue in the emergency line. or Door Sensor is moving abnormally from it place or not pressing properly.
We need ensure the highlighted connections are tight and tidy as per schematics.

additional_info.subject: Ticket closed
additional_info.body:
Finnish colleague exchanged parts
Here the remarks:
Broken converter removed with damaged wiring harnesses.
Charger working now limited 280kw power. I didn’t have AC-side wiring harness with me so I couldn’t install new converter.
Due to environmental conditions (moisture and water) I think this is not warranty case.
